RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current 60-second window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the oldest request expires and another slot opens.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait after a 429 response.

error.description: a short stable code: invalid_request, invalid_payment, body_too_large, payment_in_progress, rate_limited, unavailable, upstream_failed, not_fetched, settlement_failed, expired, internal_error, not_found, method_not_allowed

mpp.description: MPP evm/authorization credential in Authorization header. First request without payment returns WWW-Authenticate challenge.

x402.description: x402 exact payment credential. First request without payment returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED quote.
x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

info.description: Email inboxes for AI agents, by the hour: pay in stablecoins, get an address, wait for a message with one call and read the code or the link out of it. Endpoints: inbox-1h, inbox-1h-renew, inbox-4h, inbox-4h-renew, inbox-24h, inbox-24h-renew. An order returns an inbox id and a secret once the payment is accepted; the inbox takes mail when the payment has settled. GET /v1/inbox/{id}/wait and /otp (Authorization: Bearer secret) block until a message arrives. A renew call extends an inbox. Payment is in stablecoins: x402 on Base, Polygon and Solana or MPP on Base. x402 uses the exact scheme; no API keys, accounts or subscriptions. A call that cannot be served is never charged. Feedback is free: POST /feedback (or the MCP tool feedback) sends a note to the people who run the service. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy headers: they show the per-IP budget of the request class (free documents 120 per minute, unpaid quote requests 300 per minute; a request that carries a payment is never limited). Free GET documents (/openapi.json, /llms.txt, /agents.md, /pricing.md, /docs, /ask and /health) are limited to 120 requests per minute per client IP and return RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy; a 429 also includes Retry-After. API deprecation policy: https://agmail.shveik.dev/deprecation-policy.
info.title: agmail

x-api-lifecycle.deprecation: Deprecation and Sunset response headers with at least 90 days notice

info.x-guidance: POST a small JSON body (see each operation's requestBody) with no payment to get a 402 carrying a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402) and a WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge (MPP). Sign either and retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (x402) or Authorization: Payment (MPP) to receive the JSON dataset. The 402 quotes the price for your requested limit: a fixed per-call fee plus a per-result price for each result; endpoints without a limit field return one result. If fewer results come back than you asked for, the per-result price of the missing ones is refunded on-chain to the paying address (refunds too small to be worth a transfer are not sent); a scrape with no results keeps only the fixed fee and refunds every result; a failed scrape is not settled. Response headers X-Agdata-Results-Requested, X-Agdata-Results-Delivered and X-Agdata-Refund (USDC base units) report it. Results are returned as one JSON array; limit is a maximum-result count (clamped to endpoint bounds). Paid results have no cursor or continuation token; the only paginated resource is the free GET /endpoints list (limit, cursor, next_cursor). Calls are synchronous; scrape timeout is bounded by configured upstream and settlement windows. An occasional 202 means settlement may have reached the chain, not an asynchronous job; retry the same payment to resolve/retrieve, and there is no status URL.

get.description: Lists the paid endpoints with their paths and quote URLs, the same entries as the /v1 index. Pages hold limit entries (default 10, at most 50); when next_cursor is not null, pass it back as cursor for the next page. A malformed limit or cursor is a 400 error.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the next_cursor of the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Number of endpoints in the whole list.

get.summary: List the API endpoints, one page at a time

post.description: Get an email address for your agent for one hour: name@agmail.shveik.dev, a name of your choice or a random one. Pay in stablecoins with x402 or MPP, no account and no card. Wait for the verification mail with one call and get the code or the link back. Receive only. Extend it by paying again. Send the JSON body with no payment to get a 402 with an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate) and an x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED); sign the MPP one (evm/authorization) and retry with an Authorization header. Both paths take either protocol: /x402/<name> and /mpp/<name> are the same endpoint. GET /mpp/inbox-1h with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape.

name.description: the local part of the address; omit it for a random name

200.description: The dataset, after the payment settled.

X-Agdata-Refund.description: USDC base units refunded to the paying address for results not delivered (only when a refund is due).

X-Agdata-Results-Requested.description: Number of results the quote was for.

400.description: Invalid request: a request body that is invalid (a payment was attached; without a payment an invalid body gets the 402 below), or a payment header that cannot be read (error invalid_payment). Nothing is charged.

schema.description: The x402 PaymentRequired object (the same as the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header).

402.description: Payment required: the quote, with both challenges (also the answer when a payment was not accepted: read error). An unpaid request with an invalid body also gets this 402, quoted for 1 result, with X-Agdata-Invalid-Request: 1 and the reason in error; do not sign that one.

WWW-Authenticate.description: MPP Payment challenge (RFC 9110 auth-params): id, realm, method=evm, intent=charge, request.

X-Agdata-Invalid-Request.description: 1 when the request body is invalid and the quote is for 1 result only.

409.description: The same payment is already being worked on: wait and retry with the same payment.

410.description: The stored copy of this payment's result has expired (error expired): nothing is charged or run; sign a new payment to ask again.

413.description: The request body is over 65536 bytes.

422.description: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

429.description: Too many calls for this host or route are in flight (Retry-After: 5): no payment was taken.

500.description: Internal error: no payment was settled for it.

502.description: The upstream scrape failed (error upstream_failed), or the payment could not be settled (settlement_failed). Nothing is delivered; an upstream failure is not charged.

503.description: Temporarily unavailable (the endpoint, a payment network or the upstream is switched off or over its failure budget): no payment was taken. Try again later.

x-quote-probe.description: GET /mpp/inbox-1h with no body answers the 402 quote for one result without starting a scrape. A quote for a request-specific limit needs this POST body.
